value.rationale: The 29-vertex Paley graph is a canonical self-complementary strongly regular graph; its 3-dimensional independence/clique complex exhibits genuine integral two-torsion, unlike typical sphere wedges. Establishing the *exact* simply connected homotopy type with a Moore 2-torsion attachment is a mathematically useful refinement beyond its known homology and local pseudomanifold data. The precise invariant is natural and not mechanically implied by a homology table; exhaustive finite computation is appropriate for this fixed natural graph.

scientific_limitations: Single 29-vertex Paley graph only; precise homotopy classification uses standard CW handle/slides and Hurewicz on the independently checked finite acyclic Morse matching. Integral H2 torsion was already known and is not a novel claim.
